question: Can one explicitly expected predecessor extend one exact locally retained key-rotation-revocation checkpoint head by one direct successor without rollback or silent fork normalization?
falsifiers: non-genesis accepted without retained predecessor history
older sequence silently replaces retained newer head
same-sequence conflict is normalized instead of exposed
sequence gap is treated as continuous
foreign signer advances expected predecessor lineage
link does not bind exact checkpoint digest
link predates the checkpoint it names
success is promoted into global freshness, synchronization, fork resolution, authority transfer, or CANON
truth_boundary: This evidence establishes only local anti-rollback and fork/gap visibility relative to one exact retained predecessor-signed rotation-revocation checkpoint/link head. It does not discover unseen checkpoints or revocations, prove a globally newest or globally fresh state, survive loss of retained local state, synchronize peers, resolve forks, validate referenced rotations beyond the checkpoint contract, transfer identity or authority, or establish AXM-wide CANON.
